items.title: Show signed fresh-reviewer run records to maintainers
items.context: Introduce a review_run_start command and durable review-runs artifact keyed by reviewRunId, storyId, lane, reviewRound, prompt hash, head hash, material hash, and startedAt. User-visible outcome: reviewer status and gate failures can explain which fresh run is missing or stale.
items.userSees: `koala review_run_start` prints a reviewRunId, and REVIEW gate errors name missing/stale run-bound reviewer evidence instead of accepting prompt-only reviewer claims.

happy.desc: review_run_start writes a signed review-runs.json entry with reviewRunId, storyId, reviewer lane, current reviewRound, prompt hash, headHash, materialHash, and startedAt.

edge.desc: review_run_start rejects non-reviewer lanes, missing story/worktree context, and attempts outside an active currentReviewRound.

adversarial.desc: A tampered review run signature or mismatched lane cannot be treated as valid reviewer run evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: assertReviewRunStartCliSurface verifies review_run_start persists signed review-runs.json fields including reviewRunId, lane, reviewRound, promptHash, headHash, materialHash, and startedAt.
assertReviewRunStartCliSurface rejects unsupported reviewer lane and REVIEW stories without currentReviewRound, and stale run reuse after material changes.
assertReviewRunBindingRejectsInvalidEvidence verifies tampered review-runs signatures and wrong-lane run bindings are rejected by the REVIEW gate.

items.title: Bind reviewer findings and passes to reviewRunId
items.context: review_pass_set and finding_add should accept reviewRunId and record it in signed artifacts; current-round REVIEW gate should require valid run-bound evidence for new review rounds. User-visible outcome: review status and gate errors show which lane has valid run-bound pass/finding evidence and why stale/mismatched evidence is rejected.
items.userSees: `koala session_brief` / REVIEW→TEST failures identify missing or stale run-bound evidence per reviewer lane, while valid `review_pass_set` and `finding_add` output includes the accepted reviewRunId linkage.

happy.desc: review_pass_set and finding_add accept reviewRunId, persist it in signed artifacts, and REVIEW status counts valid current run-bound pass/finding evidence.

edge.desc: Legacy evidence remains readable for old stories without currentReviewRound, but current REVIEW rounds require run-bound evidence for required lanes.

adversarial.desc: REVIEW→TEST rejects missing reviewRunId, stale run hash, wrong lane, wrong round, or evidence created before the active REVIEW round.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Valid current reviewRunId-bound findings and review passes are persisted, signed, counted by reviewer status, and allow REVIEW gate success.
assertLegacyReviewEvidenceWithoutCurrentRoundStaysReadable proves old stories without currentReviewRound keep legacy signed review pass readability while new rounds require run-bound evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Tests assert REVIEW gate failures for missing reviewRunId, wrong lane, tampered signature, and stale material hash before accepting reviewer evidence.

items.title: Update reviewer prompts, dispatch guidance, and process-fact contract
items.context: Koala-generated reviewer guidance should call review_run_start first and include reviewRunId in review_pass_set or finding_add. Process-fact registry and scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs must include the review-run artifact and REVIEW gate semantics so prompt drift cannot bypass the hard contract.
items.userSees: Reviewer dispatch text shows `review_run_start` before pass/finding commands, and `verify-process-fact-contract` fails if the review-run gate artifact is not registered.

happy.desc: Reviewer dispatch and reviewer prompts tell reviewers to run review_run_start first and pass reviewRunId into review_pass_set/finding_add.
process-fact-registry and verify-process-fact-contract register review_run_start and review-runs.json as signed gate evidence.

edge.desc: Prompt examples for pass-only findings still use review_pass_set rather than finding_add and include reviewRunId.

adversarial.desc: Contract verification fails synthetic prompt/registry drift where review_run_start or reviewRunId is omitted from reviewer evidence flow.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-pass-discard-smoke && node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex
verificationEvidence.note: Reviewer dispatch output now includes review_run_start before finding_add/review_pass_set, and Codex adapter verification confirms mirrored reviewer prompts are synchronized.
Process fact contract verifies review_run_start, signed review-runs.json, review-run-boundary policy, registry levels, CLI schema, and gate semantics are registered.
Prompt drift scan fails pass-only finding examples and reviewer evidence examples lacking reviewRunId; all active reviewer prompt/template copies passed.
Synthetic contract checks now require review_run_start and reviewRunId for reviewer evidence flow, preventing prompt-only drift from satisfying the contract.

items.title: Prove stale or missing review runs produce clear gate signals
items.context: Tests should prove REVIEW cannot pass with stale reviewRunId, wrong lane, missing run id in current flow, or pre-REVIEW evidence, while valid run-bound findings/passes still work. User-visible outcome: failure messages and status summaries distinguish missing fresh run, stale hash, wrong lane, and successful current-run evidence.
items.userSees: Regression smoke output shows stale/missing reviewRunId cases are rejected with actionable REVIEW→TEST messages, and valid current-run evidence still lets the reviewer gate pass.

happy.desc: Focused smokes pass for valid run-bound reviewer passes/findings and show current-review evidence can advance REVIEW→TEST.

edge.desc: Regression coverage keeps old-story compatibility without currentReviewRound while enforcing reviewRunId for new REVIEW rounds.

adversarial.desc: Regression coverage asserts actionable gate failures for stale/missing/wrong-lane reviewRunId cases and pre-REVIEW evidence reuse.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-pass-discard-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke suite passes for valid run-bound reviewer evidence, prompt/dispatch guidance, and review pass/finding persistence.
Legacy no-currentReviewRound evidence remains readable while current REVIEW rounds enforce reviewRunId binding.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Regression coverage asserts actionable failures for stale, missing, wrong-lane, and tampered reviewRunId cases.
